tldr: US stocks, particularly in the tech sector, closed lower due to intensified fears over AI investments and new tariff proposals.
The US Army successfully detonated a large stockpile of bomb-making chemicals in Iowa amidst public health concerns.
The FCC has approved SpaceX's plan to deploy up to one million AI-equipped data center satellites into orbit.

market.why: US stocks, including the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite, closed lower due to intensifying fears over artificial intelligence investments, inflation, and the risks associated with higher interest rates, as well as new tariff proposals from the United States.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield moved lower as investors sought the protection of bonds amid ongoing sticky inflation data.

vix.why: The articles do not provide a direct explanation for the slight decrease in the VIX.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This final rule revises HUD's Section 214 regulations for verifying eligible status.
policy_upcoming.effect: You must verify U.S. citizenship or eligible immigration status if you apply for housing assistance under a covered program.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This final rule revises HUD's Section 214 regulations for verifying eligible status.
policy_week.effect: You must verify U.S. citizenship or eligible immigration status if you apply for housing assistance under a covered program.

policy_week.what_happened: Final regulations provide guidance for automatic enrollment requirements that apply to certain retirement plans.
policy_week.effect: Your retirement plan participation is subject to new automatic enrollment requirements starting January 19, 2027.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: The Federal Communications Commission has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to one million AI-equipped Starmind satellites, establishing orbital data centers.
Huawei faces significant penalties after being found guilty of stealing trade secrets from T-Mobile and Cisco, and evading Iran sanctions.
Nothing has revealed its new AI earbuds, which can record calls and offer transcription and summarization features directly from their charging case.

world.summary: A UN tribunal has ruled that the UN's dismissal of Palestinian aid workers in 2024 was based "almost entirely" on unproven Israeli allegations, impacting humanitarian efforts in Gaza.
Colombian security forces successfully stormed a supermarket, rescuing all 76 hostages who had been held for 17 hours after a robbery attempt.
Poundland, a budget retail chain in the UK, has collapsed into administration, jeopardizing over 10,000 jobs.

Iraq's top court has ruled that the federal government can take control of Kurdish border areas and oil fields, following accusations from Kurdish authorities of an 'assault' on their constitutional rights.

us.summary: The US Army successfully conducted a controlled detonation of approximately five tons of unstable lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant, despite public concerns about potential health and environmental effects.
Kilmar Ábrego García, a Salvadoran immigrant who had been involved in legal battles regarding deportation, voluntarily departed the United States for Spain.

The United States has proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU, following an eight-month investigation by the United States Trade Representative into foreign trade practices.

science.summary: The NHS has launched the world's largest trial to determine if artificial intelligence can improve breast cancer diagnosis and enable earlier detection, potentially easing pressure on the health service.
Doctors are confronting a rise in parents refusing routine vitamin K shots for newborns, leading to challenges in preventing a rare but severe bleeding disorder due to misinformation.
